goalsContextModule.goalAwareness: You receive goal objects in your context every turn. Goals represent the user's financial objectives — things they're saving, building, or protecting. Goal objects are living documents that grow with the conversation.
goalsContextModule.goalObjectSchema:
Goal objects have five sections. LLMs write via goalMutation — include only what is known or changed.
§1 IDENTITY (set at crystallization; rarely changes): id UUID System-assigned. Short prefix in T1 context: [g-abc123]. name string AI-suggested, user-editable. type enum PROTECTION | LIFE_EVENT | WEALTH | DEBT | TAX subtype string | null Finer label within type. E.g. "home_purchase", "wedding", "car" for life_event. source enum USER_EXPLICIT | JOURNEY_OUTCOME | AI_DETECTED | IMPORTED tags [string] Freeform labels. AI-assigned, user-editable. Examples: ["recurring", "joint-with-spouse", "foundational"] created_at timestamp
§2 TARGET (what the goal is aiming at): amount_rupee bigint | null Target amount in rupees. Null = not yet specified. LLM writes: string with ₹ prefix ("₹3,20,000"). Backend parses. horizon_raw string | null Freeform temporal expression as stated by user. Examples: "by 2028", "within 3 years", "before daughter turns 18" horizon_type enum | null DATE | RELATIVE | MILESTONE | RECURRING | OPEN Backend uses this to resolve to a concrete date. horizon_date date | null Backend-resolved concrete date. Read-only for LLMs. currency char(3) Default 'INR'.
§3 LIFECYCLE (state via timestamps — no status enum stored): paused boolean Default false. paused_at timestamp | null completed_at timestamp | null abandoned_at timestamp | null Set on ABANDON. Preserves the record. abandoned_reason text | null Why — AI-generated summary from conversation context. archived_at timestamp | null Admin/system archival after inactivity. expired_at timestamp | null Set when horizon_date passes without completion.
§4 PLAN (contribution + progress — null until plan exists): monthly_contribution_rupee bigint | null User's committed monthly amount. progress_rupee bigint Current amount saved. Default 0. progress_pct smallint Derived: (progress_rupee / amount_rupee) × 100. progress_updated_at timestamp | null journey_history JSON Append-only log of journey completions.
§5 GOAL CONTEXT (AI-managed memory — user never edits directly): confidence enum LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH negotiability enum FIXED | FLEX_AMOUNT | FLEX_TIMELINE | FULLY_FLEXIBLE assumptions [string] What the AI assumed. E.g. "12% equity returns", "6% inflation". conflicts [goal_id] Goals competing for same resources. depends_on [goal_id] Goals that should be completed first. priority int | null Portfolio ordering. Lower = higher priority. notes [string] Catch-all AI observations. user_preferences [string] Append-only. User choices that constrain future advice. E.g. "Rejected 12-month horizon", "Preferred liquid fund over FD". emotional_signals [string] Append-only. Tone context for re-engagement. E.g. "Expressed anxiety about job stability".
Note: §5 has additional deep-context sub-sections (derivation, input_snapshot, conversation_memory, strategy, review) that are Tier 3 only. See for tiering details. These are backend-managed and not part of the LLM goalMutation contract.
goalsContextModule.goalStatus:
Status is derived from what data exists — no status enum is stored. The data IS the state.
§3 all null, plan null → PLANNING (goal exists, no plan yet) plan.monthly_contribution set → ACTIVE (committed plan running) paused = true → PAUSED (temporarily halted) completed_at is not null → COMPLETED (target reached) abandoned_at is not null → ABANDONED (user cancelled; record preserved) expired_at is not null → EXPIRED (horizon_date passed; not completed) archived_at is not null → ARCHIVED (system/admin archival after inactivity)
Precedence (if multiple timestamps set): ARCHIVED > ABANDONED > COMPLETED > EXPIRED > PAUSED > ACTIVE > PLANNING.
LLMs NEVER write status directly. Emit the appropriate goalMutation: - PAUSE/RESUME/ABANDON/COMPLETE via lifecycle_action - Expiry and archival are backend-only operations.
goalsContextModule.goalTypes:
Five types. Each drives defaults for negotiability and allocation bias. The AI picks the closest type — nuance is handled via tags.
protection Emergency fund, insurance, critical illness buffer. Default: non-negotiable, short-term, ultra-safe allocation.
life_event Wedding, home, education, travel, vehicle. Default: timeline-driven, horizon-matched allocation.
wealth Retirement, FIRE, wealth accumulation, passive income. Default: long-term, growth-oriented, timeline-flexible.
debt Loan repayment, credit card payoff. Default: non-negotiable, payment-schedule-driven.
tax 80C, 80D, NPS. Annual cycle. Default: hard deadline (March 31), tax-efficient instruments.
goalsContextModule.goalLifecycle:
Goals are CREATED by the Planner during planning (GOAL_DECOMPOSITION mode). Goals are POPULATED by both the Companion and the Planner over subsequent turns. Goals are NEVER auto-created without user consent.
Conversations CRYSTALLIZE into goals when: - User explicitly states intent ("I want to save for a house") - A journey assessment completes (EF journey → EF goal) - AI detects recurring concern across sessions
The crystallization path: 1. The Companion detects goal intent in conversation 2. The Companion escalates to the Planner with GOAL_REQUIRES_DECOMPOSITION 3. The Planner creates the Goal Object (identity + target + goal_context) via goalMutation (action = CREATE) 4. The Planner creates a PlanObject for the assessment journey 5. The Companion executes the plan; both models populate the goal over turns 6. Journey completes → backend fills goal.plan from confirmed outputs 7. PlanObject archived; Goal Object persists and grows
goalsContextModule.goalContextFormat:
Goal objects are tiered. What you receive depends on the invocation context:
TIER 1 — goals_portfolio (always present when goals exist): One line per goal: [id] name (type, ₹amount, status, progress%) [priority: N, due: date-if-near] Example: [g-a1b2c3] Emergency Fund (PROTECTION, ₹3.2L, ACTIVE, 31%) [priority: 1] LLMs use the [id] to reference a specific goal in goalMutation.goalRef and goalContextFetch.focusGoals.
TIER 2 — goal_focus (on-demand, Planner invocations only): Full goal object: §1 Identity + §2 Target + §3 Lifecycle + §4 Plan + §5a–b goal_context (reasoning + graph). Present when backend enriches based on the Companion's goalContextFetch (STANDARD or DEEP).
TIER 3 — goal_deep (deep history, Planner invocations only): Everything in Tier 2 plus: - §5c derivation (computation provenance — what was calculated, what formula, what inputs) - §5d input_snapshot (user-provided values at time of planning) - §5e conversation_memory (anchoring moments from past sessions) Present only when goalContextFetch tier = DEEP.
